attacks.claim: `_upload` builds a shell command by f-string interpolation with `shell=True`, and `src.stem` comes from partner-chosen SFTP filenames. A crafted filename containing shell metacharacters runs arbitrary commands on the worker, which holds write credentials for the whole raw bucket.
attacks.evidence: subprocess.run(f"gsutil -q -o GSUtil:parallel_composite_upload_threshold=150M cp {local} {dest}", shell=True, check=True) with dest = f"gs://{BUCKET}/raw/{partner}/dt={dt}/{src_name}/{local.name}" and "Partners upload via SFTP and choose their own filenames"
